summary: Frontend-only sweep of iteration_115. The P0 XdrScopeNavigator crash is FIXED and CONFIRMED (SCOPE_CRASH=0 across every run, zero occurrences of 'destroy is not a function' or '<XdrScopeNavigator>' in console, zero data-testid=xdr-scope-navigator-error mounted). REG4, REG5 (at API level), the new Entities workspace, Findings surface, Activity table (extended), Capability Runs view, cross-tab regression, and 7/8 legacy /xdr/investigations redirects all pass. Only two soft findings: (a) timeline tab briefly renders 2 incident-tab-* bodies during transition (extra body unmounts but was visible at snapshot time), (b) /xdr/investigations/inc_.../?tab=graph did not observably redirect in one probe though the code map graph->entities is correct — very likely Cloudflare challenge interposed during that specific probe, retest recommended. The preview host is very aggressive with Cloudflare 429s during rapid navigation; slow pacing (>=3s between navigations) is required.

ui_bugs.issue: On the Timeline tab (only) two data-testid=incident-tab-* bodies were rendered simultaneously during a cross-tab click sequence (all_bodies=2). The active timeline tab body did render (active=1) so this is not blocking, but the tab-body isolation invariant momentarily failed — likely the previous tab's body was still mounted while timeline was mounting. Verify unmount ordering / suspense fallback in the tab slot.

One probe of /xdr/investigations/inc_c312e0180ec742778b6b?tab=graph did NOT redirect (final URL still on /xdr/investigations). All seven other legacy tabs (verdict, security_state, attack, story, evidence, trajectory, process) correctly redirected to /xdr/incidents/<id>?tab=<mapped>. The ENGINE_TAB_TO_ANALYST_TAB map explicitly has `graph: 'entities'`, so this is almost certainly a Cloudflare challenge interposing during that probe (multiple CF verification screens were captured in this run). Retest with longer inter-request pacing to confirm.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Look at the timeline-tab body isolation glitch: during rapid tab switching two [data-testid="incident-tab-*"] bodies were mounted simultaneously for a moment. Confirm the previous body unmounts synchronously when Timeline mounts.
OPTIONAL — Retest /xdr/investigations/inc_.../?tab=graph with slow pacing to distinguish a real redirect regression from Cloudflare challenge noise. Code map is correct; likely no fix needed.
NONE for the P0 — XdrScopeNavigator fix + containment error boundary are BOTH verified working. Ship it.
critical_code_review_comments: XdrScopeNavigator.jsx lines 82-97 now correctly builds a `request` value and calls `resolve(request)` without returning the promise — the fix matches the RCA in iteration_114 and the effect no longer returns a Promise. Good.

XdrShell wrapping XdrScopeNavigator in NxErrorBoundary with a data-testid=xdr-scope-navigator-error fallback is present but was not observed to render in any test (scope_err=0 everywhere), which is the desired outcome.

Cloudflare rate limiting on the preview host (137 429s in one aggressive probe, causing Vite dynamic-import failures) is not an application defect but it is worth a client-side backoff on the intelligence-overlays refresh chatter.

Overall verifiable success: ~95%.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The XdrScopeNavigator effect fix from iteration_114 (build a request value, then call resolve(request) without returning the promise) is confirmed working — every incident tab renders, no shell blank, no scope crash console signature. The containment boundary xdr-scope-navigator-error was never triggered. Cloudflare rate-limits the preview aggressively (135+ 429s during rapid navigation) which causes Vite dynamic import failures that look like page failures — pace test navigation at >=3s between routes and hard refreshes at >=5s. For REG5 UI round-trip, the Findings pane's Interpretation tab exists and the API is fine (14/14 overlay calls returned 200), but Edit/Save/Revert lack unique data-testids; a small testability improvement (add data-testid on the analyst summary textarea, reason textarea, Edit/Save/Revert buttons, and the ANALYST EDITED badge) would make automated verification bullet-proof.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new critical bug. Timeline tab-body isolation glitch is likely a missing key on the Suspense boundary around the tab slot; graph legacy redirect probe failure is most likely Cloudflare 429/challenge interference, not a code defect.
